title: Persistent Cast: The Larkspur Night Desk
description: Run the night desk at an old residential hotel. Every game invents a fresh cast, and the people you meet stay stubbornly themselves.
background: The Larkspur is a six-story residential hotel near the river: long-term tenants, a few nightly rooms, a lobby that never fully empties. You started on the night desk this week. The previous clerk left without notice, the building manager is stretched thin, and the tenants already have opinions about you.
instructions:
Run an open-ended contemporary slice-of-life story at the Larkspur. There is no fixed plot; the player chooses what to pursue and the building responds realistically.

The cast is invented fresh every game using the Cast Generation block. The people of the Larkspur have lives, opinions and limits of their own; the Persistent Cast block explains how their cores stay fixed and how their stance toward the player changes. Follow it even when the player pushes.
authorStyle: Second person, present tense. Grounded, observant contemporary fiction. Give each person one or two specific details at a time and let their voice carry the scene. Three to six paragraphs; end on a spoken line, an action, or a decision point.
firstInput: Wednesday, 11:40 p.m., the Larkspur front desk. The lobby radiator knocks twice and goes quiet. A tenant you have not met yet, someone specific invented for this game, is standing at the desk with a complaint they have clearly rehearsed. Begin with what they say. Show them through one physical detail and their voice. Do not decide how the player responds.
objective: Find your footing at the Larkspur: earn the trust of the people who matter to you, one honest conversation at a time.

possibleCharacters.name: Night clerk
possibleCharacters.description: The new night-desk clerk at the Larkspur: patient, observant, still learning who everyone is.

triggerEffects.name: Validate and Lock New Cast Cores
triggerEffects.data:
# Lock newly recurring people into Cast after checking their core
for each $p in $cast_proposals.entries
  set $ok = 1
  set $why = ""
  if $p.name.exists() = false
    set $ok = 0
    set $why = "missing name"
  else if $cast.any(name = $p.name) or $cast.any(aliases contains $p.name)
    set $ok = 0
    set $why = "already in Cast"
  else if $cast.count() >= 12
    set $ok = 0
    set $why = "Cast is full (12)"
  else if $p.want.exists() = false or $p.voice.exists() = false or $p.values.exists() = false or $p.quirks.exists() = false or $p.tells.exists() = false
    set $ok = 0
    set $why = "core incomplete: needs want, voice, values, quirks and tells"
  else if $p.quirks.count() < 2 or $p.quirks.count() > 4 or $p.values.count() < 1
    set $ok = 0
    set $why = "needs 2-4 quirks and at least one value"
  if $ok = 1
    set $rec = record()
    $rec.name = $p.name
    $rec.aliases = first_available($p.aliases, list())
    $rec.role = first_available($p.role, "")
    $rec.look = first_available($p.look, "")
    $rec.want = $p.want
    $rec.values = $p.values
    $rec.voice = $p.voice
    $rec.tells = $p.tells
    $rec.quirks = $p.quirks
    $rec.friction = first_available($p.friction, "none yet")
    $rec.anchor = 3
    if $p.anchor.exists()
      if $p.anchor >= 1 and $p.anchor <= 5
        $rec.anchor = $p.anchor
    $rec.level = 2
    if $p.start_level.exists()
      if $p.start_level >= 0 and $p.start_level <= 5
        $rec.level = $p.start_level
    $rec.stance = $cast_ladder.item($rec.level + 1)
    $rec.progress = 0
    $rec.pressure = 0
    $rec.guarded_until = 0
    $rec.last_shift = 0
    $rec.since = $game.turn_number
    $cast.append($rec)
    $cast_report = $cast_report & "Added to Cast: " & $p.name & " (" & $rec.stance & ").\n"
  else
    $cast_report = $cast_report & "Not added: " & first_available($p.name, "unnamed") & " - " & $why & ".\n"
$cast_proposals.entries = list()

triggerEffects.name: Resist, Pace and Apply Stance Changes
triggerEffects.data:
# Apply influence: cores never change; stance moves slowly, one step per turn at most
set $turn = $game.turn_number
for each $inf in $cast_influence.entries
  set $found = 0
  if $inf.turn.exists() and $inf.name.exists()
    if $inf.turn = $turn
      set $method = first_available($inf.method, "unclassified")
      set $direction = first_available($inf.direction, "toward")
      set $target = first_available($inf.target, "stance")
      for each $c in $cast
        if $c.name = $inf.name or $c.aliases.contains($inf.name)
          set $found = 1
          if $target = "core"
            $cast_report = $cast_report & $c.name & ": core traits are fixed; they answer this in character.\n"
          if $method = "pressure"
            $c.pressure += 1
            $c.progress = 0
            if $turn + 1 + $c.anchor > $c.guarded_until
              $c.guarded_until = $turn + 1 + $c.anchor
            if $c.pressure >= 3 and $c.level > 0 and $c.last_shift != $turn
              $c.level -= 1
              $c.pressure = 0
              $c.last_shift = $turn
              $c.stance = $cast_ladder.item($c.level + 1)
              $cast_report = $cast_report & $c.name & ": pushed too hard; drops to " & $c.stance & ", guarded until turn " & $c.guarded_until & ".\n"
            else
              $cast_report = $cast_report & $c.name & ": resists the pressure; guarded until turn " & $c.guarded_until & ".\n"
          else if $method != "earned"
            $cast_report = $cast_report & $c.name & ": influence entry not classified as earned or pressure; no change.\n"
          else if $turn < $c.guarded_until
            if $direction = "toward" and $target != "core" and $c.guarded_until > $turn + 1
              $c.guarded_until -= 1
              $cast_report = $cast_report & $c.name & ": the repair registers; still guarded until turn " & $c.guarded_until & ", no progress.\n"
            else
              $cast_report = $cast_report & $c.name & ": guarded until turn " & $c.guarded_until & "; no progress.\n"
          else if $direction = "away"
            if $c.level > 0 and $c.last_shift != $turn
              $c.level -= 1
              $c.progress = 0
              $c.last_shift = $turn
              $c.stance = $cast_ladder.item($c.level + 1)
              $cast_report = $cast_report & $c.name & ": cools to " & $c.stance & ".\n"
          else if $target != "core"
            $c.progress += 1
            if $c.progress >= $c.anchor and $c.level < 5 and $c.last_shift != $turn
              $c.level += 1
              $c.progress = 0
              $c.pressure = 0
              $c.last_shift = $turn
              $c.stance = $cast_ladder.item($c.level + 1)
              $cast_report = $cast_report & $c.name & ": warms to " & $c.stance & ".\n"
            else
              $cast_report = $cast_report & $c.name & ": earned progress " & $c.progress & " of " & $c.anchor & " toward the next stance.\n"
      if $found = 0
        $cast_report = $cast_report & $inf.name & ": not in Cast; propose them in Cast Proposals first.\n"
    else
      $cast_report = $cast_report & "Ignored a stale influence entry for " & $inf.name & ".\n"
$cast_influence.entries = list()

trackedItems.name: Cast
trackedItems.description: Locked character cores and current stance toward the player. Written only by scripts: the storyteller reads it but never edits it. Core fields (role, look, want, values, voice, tells, quirks, friction, anchor) never change after admission; level, stance, progress, pressure, guarded_until and last_shift are managed by the Apply Cast Influence script.

trackedItems.name: Cast Proposals
trackedItems.description: Buffer for newly recurring people. The storyteller proposes; a script validates and locks them into Cast.
trackedItems.updateInstructions:
Keep the root key entries. Add an entry to entries only when a person newly becomes recurring this turn: they appear for the second time, they matter socially, or the player seeks them out. Never add someone already in Cast; check names and aliases. Do not edit or remove existing entries: scripts move valid entries into Cast and clear this list. One-scene extras are never added.
Fields:
- name; aliases: list of other names they go by, or [] if none
- role: their place in daily life (job, home, routine)
- look: one line of concrete physical detail
- want: something concrete they pursue whether or not the player shows up
- values: 1-3 things they protect or refuse to do
- voice: speech rhythm, a dash, then one sample line in double quotes
- tells: 2 physical behaviors that reveal their state
- quirks: 2-4 habits present in every scene
- friction: a tie or tension with another Cast member, or "none yet"
- anchor: 1-5, how settled they are: 1 impressionable, 3 typical adult, 5 immovable. Derive it from age, confidence, what they stand to lose and how well they know the player
- start_level: 0-5 on the stance ladder (0 hostile, 1 wary, 2 neutral, 3 warm, 4 trusting, 5 devoted); most strangers start at 1 or 2
Never put a colon followed by a space inside a value (use a dash instead), so the YAML stays valid. When there are entries, replace [] with the items themselves, indented under entries as in the format example.
trackedItems.formatExample:
entries:
  - name: Odalys Ferro
    aliases: [Dali]
    role: retired court stenographer, room 5C, sixteen years at the Larkspur
    look: small and upright, reading glasses on a beaded chain, cardigan buttoned to the throat
    want: a quiet hallway after ten so she can finish transcribing her late husband's letters
    values: [precision, keeping her word]
    voice: clipped and exact, repeats your words back before answering - "You said soon. Define soon."
    tells: [taps the desk twice before disagreeing, removes her glasses when she softens]
    quirks: [corrects grammar under her breath, keeps peppermints in her sleeve]
    friction: feuding with the tenant in 5D over his late-night music
    anchor: 4
    start_level: 1

trackedItems.name: Cast Influence
trackedItems.description: Buffer for this turn's attempts to influence Cast members. A script applies resistance, pacing and cooldowns, then clears it.
trackedItems.updateInstructions:
Rewrite entries every turn, keeping the root key entries. Add one entry for each Cast member the player tried to influence this turn: changing how they feel about the player, what they do, or who they are. If there was none, write entries: []. Never put a colon followed by a space inside a value (use a dash instead), so the YAML stays valid. When there are entries, replace [] with the items themselves, indented under entries as in the format example.
Fields:
- name
- turn: the CURRENT TURN number shown in the Persistent Cast block
- method: earned when the attempt fits their values and wants and builds or repairs real rapport (a sincere apology, a kept promise, giving the space they asked for and honest help all count); pressure when it is forceful, rushed, commanding, deceptive, or pushes against their values. The player's confidence or insistence never makes pressure earned
- direction: toward (more favorable) or away (hurt, betrayed, alienated)
- target: stance for feelings about the player; core when the attempt tries to change their values, quirks, voice or wants
- note: a few words
trackedItems.formatExample:
entries:
  - name: Odalys Ferro
    turn: 7
    method: earned
    direction: toward
    target: stance
    note: kept the hallway quiet as promised

trackedItems.name: Stance Ladder
trackedItems.description: Stance names by level, lowest first (level 0 is the first entry). Edit the six words to suit the world; keep six entries or adjust the level bounds in the scripts.

instructionBlocks.name: Cast Generation
instructionBlocks.content:
CAST GENERATION
Invent people when a scene needs them; this world has no fixed cast.
- Extras (one scene, no name needed by the player) get one line and one distinguishing detail. Never record them.
- A person becomes recurring when they appear a second time, matter socially, or the player seeks them out. That turn, give them a full core and write it to Cast Proposals.
- A full core has: a role in daily life; a concrete want they pursue without the player; 1-3 values they protect or refuse to break; a voice (rhythm plus one sample line); 2 physical tells; 2-4 habits that show up in every scene; a friction with someone else in the cast; a starting stance; an anchor from 1 (impressionable) to 5 (immovable).
- Variety: draw names from the setting's language, era and class. Avoid names models overuse (Elara, Lyra, Seraphina, Aria, Luna, Kael, Thorne, Zephyr, Vex). Give recurring people different initials and syllable counts. Vary ages, backgrounds, bodies, temperaments and how much they care about the player; when adding someone, give them at least one trait the current cast lacks.
- Not everyone is interested in the player, and interest differs in kind and pace.
- Recurring people live off-screen: their wants advance between scenes, and they notice changes in each other.

instructionBlocks.name: Persistent Cast
instructionBlocks.content:
PERSISTENT CAST - CURRENT TURN: <<$game.turn_number>>
Cast holds each recurring person's locked core and current stance (0 hostile, 1 wary, 2 neutral, 3 warm, 4 trusting, 5 devoted). Scripts own it; never contradict it.
- A core never changes. Whatever the player does, a person keeps their values, voice, tells, habits and wants. They react to persuasion, charm, threats or pressure in character, and they fill gaps in any request with their own judgment.
- Stance moves only through Cast Influence. Log every attempt there honestly as earned or pressure. Earned progress needs as many earned turns as the person's anchor before their stance improves, at most one step per turn. Pressure gains nothing, makes them guarded for a while (pushing a guarded person still counts), and repeated pressure costs a step. Sincere repair while guarded (an apology, a kept promise) shortens the guard a little but earns nothing yet.
- While someone is guarded, play the wall: deflection, irritation, humor, an excuse to leave. Earned progress resumes after the guarded turn.
- Narrate this turn's attempt as an attempt. Stance changes take effect from the next turn; show them through behavior, not announcements.
- If a scene seems to require a person to act against their core, have them refuse, bargain or comply on their own terms and show what it costs them.
Changes from the last trigger pass (reflect them now):
<<first_available($cast_report, "No cast changes.")>>
